headings.usage: Landing page headlines, feature titles, major dashboard sections. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI labels, form inputs. Normal tracking.

mono.usage: Code snippets, AI generation outputs, technical data.

rules: Overlines must be Uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs.

primary.name: Electric Violet
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, brand moments.

theme_strategy.dashboard: Light Mode Default (Swiss & High-Contrast Archetype) with Dark Mode Toggle

borders.tracing_beam: Use for high-value cards. Animated gradient border.
borders.glass_border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for dark mode cards.

textures.noise: Overlay subtle noise texture on dark backgrounds to prevent banding.
textures.grid: Low opacity (5%) grid pattern on dashboard backgrounds.

buttons.primary: Rounded-full or sharp edges. High contrast. Hover: lift + glow.
buttons.ai_trigger: Special style with gradient border or icon animation.

cards.marketing: Glassmorphism or Tracing Beam style. Padding: p-8.
cards.dashboard: Flat, 1px border, no shadow (Swiss style). Padding: p-6.

inputs.style: Shadcn Input. Customize focus ring to match Primary color.

marketing_grid.name: The Tetris Grid
marketing_grid.rules: Asymmetry is key. Use col-span-8 for hero, col-span-4 for supporting.

dashboard_grid.name: The Control Room
dashboard_grid.rules: Dense packing. 100% height utilization. No jagged bottoms.

spacing.rule: Use 2x more spacing than standard templates.

scroll.effect: Smooth momentum scrolling for marketing pages.

hero_abstract.usage: Hero section background or feature visualization

team_collaboration.usage: About page or 'Built for teams' section

universal_guidelines: Dark colors must be used independently, not as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index).
NEVER center align the App container.
Use pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow these guidelines strictly. Use the provided image URLs. Implement the 'Tetris Grid' for the landing page and 'Control Room' for the dashboard. Use Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'Electric Violet' and 'Deep Void' theme. Ensure dark mode is default for marketing.
